about_the_game:
Still House

A peaceful home-building sandbox where creativity meets comfort. Design your dream home with cozy furniture, serene environments, and an helper who tends to small chores while you relax. Watch your space come to life as your world gently evolves, even when you're away.

Features

  • Build Freely: Place furniture, walls, lights, plants, and more with an intuitive drag-and-drop system. No pressure, just peaceful decorating.

  • Cozy Vibes: Soft lighting, ambient sounds, and warm aesthetics help create a relaxing, slow-paced experience.

  • AI Housemate: A gentle character lives in your home, doing small tasks, watering plants, brewing tea, or fluffing cushions, bringing life to your world.

  • Different Biomes: Set your house in a snowy forest, a desert hill, or a lakeside glade, each with unique weather and sounds.

  • Ambient Soundtrack: Calm lo-fi and acoustic tunes that adapt to your environment and time of day.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 or equivalent
